rows.label: qst640502_msg0001
rows.name: I'll read it for you. This is easy.

rows.label: qst640502_msg0003
rows.name: For safety, the activation code is...

rows.label: qst640502_msg0005
rows.name: If you use these to rewrite it...

rows.label: qst640502_msg0007
rows.name:
The data is corrupted, so I can only
read fragments, but this sounds
interesting.

rows.label: qst640502_msg0009
rows.name: KOS-MOS Re:, you're always so calm.

rows.label: qst640502_msg0010
rows.name:
Doesn't curiosity well up from deep
inside you?

rows.label: qst640502_msg0011
rows.name:
Aren't you curious what on earth will
start moving if we gather both
activation codes?

rows.label: qst640502_msg0012
rows.name: I can predict it, so I am not curious.

rows.label: qst640502_msg0013
rows.name:
A prediction isn't enough. You have to
see the truth with your own eyes.

rows.label: qst640502_msg0014
rows.name:
Come on, let's go defeat the Sealing
Royals. All right, Driver?
